$comment: Generated from yp_video/web/train_requests.py via make_train_schemas.py — do not edit by hand.

dataset.description: Dataset name recorded in the run.
dataset.title: Dataset

frame_dir.description: Frame-cache directory; empty uses the source's default.
frame_dir.title: Frame Dir

save_dir.description: Run directory override; empty picks a timestamped dir under exp/.
save_dir.title: Save Dir

checkpoint_dir.description: Checkpoint-package directory override; empty derives it from the run name.
checkpoint_dir.title: Checkpoint Dir

init_checkpoint.description: Empty trains from scratch; a package from action-checkpoints/ fine-tunes from it.
init_checkpoint.title: Init Checkpoint

audio_backend.description: logmel adds late-fusion audio (precomputed before training); none trains a pure-visual model. Must match at inference.
audio_backend.title: Audio Backend

temporal_arch.description: Temporal head over the frame features.
temporal_arch.title: Temporal Arch

sample_fps.description: Per-video frame stride targeting this sampling rate, so clip_len spans the same wall-clock time on 30fps and 60fps sources. 0 = every frame.
sample_fps.title: Sample Fps

acc_grad_iter.description: Split each optimizer step into N micro-batches (batch_size must divide evenly) — heavy backbones keep the effective batch without the VRAM.
acc_grad_iter.title: Acc Grad Iter

criterion.description: Which epoch counts as best: top validation mAP or lowest loss.
criterion.title: Criterion

start_val_epoch.description: Skip validation before this epoch to save time early in a long run.
start_val_epoch.title: Start Val Epoch

epoch_num_frames.description: Frames sampled per epoch; empty uses the trainer's default budget.
epoch_num_frames.title: Epoch Num Frames

predict_location.description: Also learn WHERE on the court each action happens.
predict_location.title: Predict Location

predict_actor.description: Also learn WHICH PLAYER acted, from the actor-candidate sidecar. Rejected up front when the label snapshot has no actor work.
predict_actor.title: Predict Actor

stop_vllm.description: Stop the vLLM server first to free its GPU memory for training.
stop_vllm.title: Stop Vllm

training_mode.description: split holds out a seeded val_ratio of videos; all trains on everything; holdout validates on exactly holdout_videos.
training_mode.title: Training Mode

val_ratio.description: split mode: fraction of videos held out as the validation split.
val_ratio.title: Val Ratio

split_seed.description: Seed for the train/val video shuffle — keep it fixed to compare runs.
split_seed.title: Split Seed

holdout_videos.description: holdout mode: the exact videos to hold out as the validation set; every other labelled video trains. Entries may be the raw stem, <stem>.mp4, or <stem>_actions.jsonl.
holdout_videos.title: Holdout Videos

camera_view.description: Train on all views together or restrict to one camera view.
camera_view.title: Camera View

include_predictions.description: Also train on videos that only have SPOT pre-annotations (no human labels). Pseudo-labeled videos always land on the training side, so this needs holdout mode — a random split would leak them into validation.
include_predictions.title: Include Predictions

title: AnnotationActionTrainRequest
